description: Typed CHECK-IN templates of the analysis route (docs/workflow/checklists/check-ins.md). The controller renders each check-in from run state through the route adapter (ravel.controller.routes.analysis.checkins) and the authority service's checkin.v1 renderer. Universal sections (preamble; waypoint for go; results for final) are supplied by the route; plan, flags, options and respond are generated by the authority service. 'legacy' maps each section to the validate_checkin section key whose presence and placeholder rules apply.

titles.resource_census: What exists online for this analysis (resource census)
titles.figure_target: Figure target and the early-verification waypoint
titles.method: Method, statistic, compute plan and cost
titles.scan_grid: Scan grid approved with this plan

review_items.text: Section (i-b) names what exists online for the requested analysis, rung by rung; an unreachable source is reported as unreachable, never as absent.
The selected routine, final state, collision energy, model basis and detector mode match the request, or every mismatch is a stated bounded approximation.
Figure targets and axis scales come from the actual allowed reference and preserve every requested panel; the waypoint is cheap, early and discriminating.
The plan states the method rung, the statistic the request asks for and a cost record for the highest rung; unknown cost reads as unknown, never as zero.
Every result-sensitive assumption is a numbered flag with its reason and alternatives; every trap hit carries a flag or an escalation (P3).
No section is hollow: each carries content a physicist can act on, not a restatement of the request.

titles.expectation: What was expected and what was found

review_items.text: The waypoint figure and numbers are the adopted artifacts the evidence manifest pins, produced at the approved smoke rung.
A reference-withheld run shows no published gallery, figure target or value; its waypoints are source-independent checks.

titles.verification: Verification panel (Tier A and Tier B)
titles.scan_population: Scan population: completed points and explicit holes

review_items.text: Every number in the results traces to an accepted artifact; unmatched numbers are labelled unverified.
The recipe ledger is the current one with every unknown row unchanged.
For a scan, every approved grid point is completed or an explicit hole with its failure status.
